newsitem.title: USA: Baxter says Immuno purchase value lowered.
newsitem.headline: Baxter says Immuno purchase value lowered.

text.p: Baxter International Inc said the total estimated value of its acquisition of Switzerland's Immuno International AG has been reduced to about $623 million from about $715 million.
The reduction resulted from a stronger dollar versus the Swiss franc and from an acceleration in the projected closing of the transaction, said a Baxter spokeswoman.
The deal had been expected to close over the next three years, but has been moved up to mid-year 1997, cutting the cost of the acquisition, the spokeswoman said.
The company said it has completed the first step in its acquisition of Immuno by acquiring shares from the company's controlling shareholders.
A tender offer remains to be made as the second step, followed by the third step of purchasing the remaining private shares of the company, Baxter said.
